build_ScoreHLRSampler: build a ScoreHLRSampler instance with num, pos_fraction, and context for importance-based sample reweighting in object detection
create_random_choice: create a random selection of elements from a gallery tensor or list using ScoreHLRSampler.random_choice
test_sample_pos: test the _sample_pos method to randomly sample positive bounding box samples from assign results
review_sample_neg: review the _sample_neg method that computes Score-HLR and samples negative bboxes with NMS-Match grouping
summarize_sample: summarize the sample method that samples positive and negative bboxes and returns SamplingResult with label weights
